terrain:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production source sprite atlas for an original 2D side-view pixel-art Metroidvania forest. Genuine transparent RGBA background.
Create exactly sixteen square terrain tile designs in a perfectly regular 4 columns by 4 rows sheet, no margins, no gutters, no labels. Every cell must be the same size. Draw actual crisp low-resolution pixel art, intended to reduce each cell to 16x16 native pixels; hard pixel clusters, no smoothing, no painterly strokes.
Material: rounded milk-fantasy woodland, bright but modest moss green grass lip over dark cocoa and green-gray earth with sparse embedded rounded stones and roots. Cohesive palette: deep #16241a shadow, forest #2d4934, moss #60864a, light moss #92ae65, earth #4b3c2b, rock #65705b. Grass ledge readable; soil softly varied with broad shapes. No flowers, characters, items, text.
The 16 cells in exact row-major order:
Row1: 1 top-left outer corner, 2 repeating flat grassy top edge, 3 top-right outer corner, 4 repeating left soil cliff edge.
Row2: 5 seamless full soil center fill, 6 repeating right soil cliff edge, 7 bottom-left outer corner with hanging root, 8 repeating soil bottom.
Row3: 9 bottom-right outer corner, 10 one standalone square grassy dirt block with all sides visible, 11 thin grassy platform left tip, 12 thin grassy platform repeating middle.
Row4: 13 thin grassy platform right tip, 14 inner concave corner left, 15 inner concave corner right, 16 grass-to-cave mossy stone transition fill.
Solid tiles have completely opaque interiors and square aligned edges that match adjacent tiles. Only outward-facing borders may have transparency. All centers and seam edges use matching earth textures. Thin platforms occupy upper half of cell with clear transparent below. Orthographic side elevation only. No top faces, no perspective, no isometric, no display frame, no checkerboard printed in image. Maximize clarity at sixteen pixels per cell.
scenery:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable transparent pixel-art scenery modules for a 2D side-view woodland Metroidvania, consistent with a 16x16 terrain grid and 640x360 screen.
Create a regular 3 columns by 3 rows modular source sheet with exactly nine separate objects, each entirely inside its own cell and surrounded by generous genuinely transparent alpha space; no objects touching across cells, no frame, labels, writing or cast shadow outside object.
Original rounded milk-fantasy woodland pixel art. Crisp chunky pixels, stepped silhouettes, limited colors, no smooth brushwork. Orthographic SIDE ELEVATION, absolutely no isometric or top-down perspective. Moss green, dark forest green, cocoa wood, muted sage highlights. Objects should form clean legible silhouettes after reducing to 16px-grid dimensions.
Exact row-major cell subjects:
Row 1 left: ONE monumental broad ancient tree trunk with a fork and a few massive roots at ground level, its top cut naturally behind foliage, only trunk and roots, no canopy. Row1 center: ONE wide rounded dense tree canopy crown, loose underside clusters, no trunk. Row1 right: ONE substantial twisting exposed tree root arch resting on ground.
Row2 left: ONE hanging vine bundle descending from a short horizontal branch, clear dangling ends. Row2 center: left surviving end of a broken wooden rope bridge, plank deck extends from left edge to a jagged broken right end, support stakes and broken rope, deck horizontally level. Row2 right: right surviving end of the same broken wooden rope bridge, jagged broken left end, matching support stakes and broken rope.
Row3 left: ONE cluster of three rounded mossy gray-green rocks, large medium small rhythm. Row3 center: ONE mossy natural cave entrance rock arch with dark empty opening, exposed roots draping top, ground line flat and obvious, no background. Row3 right: ONE compact fern and low bush cluster, broad leaves and a few pale milk mushrooms at bottom, no collectible.
Strong large/medium/small grouping, not many scattered flecks. Rich modest moss texture, readable grass and bark edges, no neon glow. Trees and decorations will be background/decoration only, don't draw collision-platform grass strips on them. No people, creatures, buildings, items, symbols, effects or scenic backdrop. Genuine transparent background not a drawn checkerboard.
background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: far background for a 2D side-scrolling milk-fantasy woodland Metroidvania, designed for a 640x360 internal game screen. Wide 16:9 landscape image, full opaque picture.
Make an original tranquil mysterious old forest seen in strict orthographic side elevation. Large dark tree trunks and broad grouped canopy silhouettes form a clear large/medium/small rhythm. One especially broad ancient tree stands left of center as memorable landmark; its trunk rises out of view, no literal foreground platform. A gentle pale sage-green atmospheric opening in the central upper distance suggests an onward route. Keep the middle and lower middle of the frame open and simple for gameplay readability. Ground and ledges are NOT drawn in this background layer. No walkable-looking horizontal surfaces. No hanging bridges. A few distant thinner tree silhouettes for parallax depth. Small soft rounded milk-fantasy character in foliage shapes only, no creatures.
Hand-crafted pixel art with consistent large clusters and crisp stepped edges; make this a true low-resolution pixel game background suitable for downsample to 640x360, no painted fine speckle. Primary base #16241a, distance #243b2d and #304f38, restrained muted highlights #547252. Very low contrast and low saturation so bright characters and green moss terrain remain readable. No black foreground vignette, no sharp highlights, no beams or glowing orbs, no blue sky. Layer hierarchy: the large tree left provides spatial memory, dark trees frame edges; quiet central negative space. No characters, enemies, UI, text, lettering, grid, watermarks or scenic frame. Not isometric. Background must be easy to repeat by adjacent mirrored sections.
